title: ticfac sandbox image needs ticfac's source tree, so the container's declared-image check is always skipped
body: internal/cli/sandbox.go:114-123 resolves the default tk version with sandboximage.PinnedTkVersion(), which walks up from the cwd to a go.mod and reads image/Dockerfile. It does this even under --declared-only. In a worker container there is no ticfac checkout, so the verb exits 1. image/common.sh:1056 swallows the failure (|| declared=""), and check_declared_image never refuses a mismatched image. Reproduced: a repo declaring [sandbox] image, `ticfac sandbox image --declared-only --root <repo>` run from outside the module gives exit 1 'no go.mod above'. Fix: read the pin from the embedded image/ FS, or skip version resolution under --declared-only, and add a test run outside the module root.
demonstrating_check: ticfac sandbox image --declared-only --root <repo declaring [sandbox].image>, run from a directory outside the ticfac module
